property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true (the reference guarantees true return on successful completion); the mutant breaks this by returning false for the same inputs.

For any non-empty _tos and matching v array the reference C.transfer(...) always returns true when it completes (does not revert); the mutant returns false for the same completing calls, so asserting the return-boolean is true distinguishes them.

For any non-empty _tos array and matching v array where the call to the external caddress completes (does not revert), the reference C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant returns false for such inputs, so the return boolean distinguishes them.

For every non-empty _tos array and any caddress (including contracts that may revert), if C.transfer(...) completes (does not revert) then it returns true; the mutant returns false for completing calls so asserting the returned boolean is true distinguishes them.

For every non-empty _tos with matching v lengths and any callee behavior, if the reference C.transfer call completes (does not revert) then it returns true; the mutant returns false for the same completing calls, so asserting the returned boolean is true distinguishes them.
